entries.title: Proverbs 4:1
segments: ¶Give ear, my sons, to the teaching of a father; give attention so that you may have knowledge:

entries.title: Proverbs 4:2
segments: For I give you good teaching; do not give up the knowledge you are getting from me.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:3
segments: For I was a son to my father, a gentle and an only one to my mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:4
segments: And he gave me teaching, saying to me, Keep my words in your heart; keep my rules so that you may have life:

entries.title: Proverbs 4:5
segments: Get wisdom, get true knowledge; keep it in memory, do not be turned away from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:6
segments: Do not give her up, and she will keep you; give her your love, and she will make you safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:7
segments: The first sign of wisdom is to get wisdom; go, give all you have to get true knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:8
segments: Put her in a high place, and you will be lifted up by her; she will give you honour, when you give her your love.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:9
segments: She will put a crown of grace on your head, giving you a head-dress of glory.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:10
segments: Give ear, O my son, and let your heart be open to my sayings; and long life will be yours.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:11
segments: I have given you teaching in the way of wisdom, guiding your steps in the straight way.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:12
segments: When you go, your way will not be narrow, and in running you will not have a fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:13
segments: Take learning in your hands, do not let her go: keep her, for she is your life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:14
segments: ¶Do not go in the road of sinners, or be walking in the way of evil men.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:15
segments: Keep far from it, do not go near; be turned from it, and go on your way.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:16
segments: For they take no rest till they have done evil; their sleep is taken away if they have not been the cause of someone's fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:17
segments: The bread of evil-doing is their food, the wine of violent acts their drink.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:18
segments: But the way of the upright is like the light of early morning, getting brighter and brighter till the full day.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:19
segments: The way of sinners is dark; they see not the cause of their fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:20
segments: ¶My son, give attention to my words; let your ear be turned to my sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:21
segments: Let them not go from your eyes; keep them deep in your heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:22
segments: For they are life to him who gets them, and strength to all his flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:23
segments: And keep watch over your heart with all care; so you will have life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:24
segments: Put away from you an evil tongue, and let false lips be far from you.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:25
segments: Keep your eyes on what is in front of you, looking straight before you.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:26
segments: Keep a watch on your behaviour; let all your ways be rightly ordered.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:27
segments: Let there be no turning to the right or to the left, keep your feet from evil.
